about.title: About & Safety
about.disclaimerText: This platform is NOT a replacement for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. AI systems can make mistakes. Always contact emergency services (112) for serious emergencies.
about.privacyText: We do not permanently store your symptom descriptions. Only anonymous emergency category data is collected to improve the service. Location is only requested when finding nearby hospitals.
about.step1: Describe the emergency using text or voice
about.step2: AI categorizes the emergency and determines severity
about.step3: Safety rules ensure appropriate guidance is provided
about.creditsText: First-aid guidance based on protocols from Red Cross, WHO, and St John Ambulance.
